rosterBasis.policy: The user-provided 2026-08-23 roster snapshot is the requested identity basis. Public-profile and current-roster conflicts are preserved explicitly instead of silently changing the roster.

semantics.contract: Only a current publicly verifiable expiration date is promoted to endDate. Post-GCD transfers, stale dates, and source conflicts remain null or status-labelled; salary, buyout, and start date are excluded.
semantics.career: Public team-history periods with source precision retained.
semantics.honors: Major public team achievements and individual awards; not every minor event, weekly award, or placement.
semantics.prizeMoney: Approximate cumulative public tournament winnings in USD; not salary, bonus, buyout, or market value.
semantics.age: Completed age as of 2026-08-24. Age is null when the exact birth date is unavailable or reputable sources conflict.
